name: personal-claude-setups
description: Cory Hanson's personal Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: resolve-pr-feedback
plugins.description: Systematically fetch, evaluate, and resolve GitHub PR review feedback with explicit human approval gates before any changes are made.

plugins.name: explore-haiku
plugins.description: Overrides Claude Code's built-in Explore agent to always run on Haiku instead of inheriting the session model, cutting cost and latency on every exploration dispatch.

plugins.name: dotnet-dev-agents
plugins.description: Domain-specific subagents for .NET/C# development: API design, Blazor/MudBlazor components, EF Core migrations, Serilog logging, security review, feature-flag removal, xUnit test coverage, and Markdown documentation.
